missions.name: Outpost Alpha
missions.briefing: Defend Sentinel-7. Destroy incoming drones before they reach the outpost.
missions.story: The Varkon Empire has crossed the southern border. Sentinel-7 must hold Outpost Alpha while the last civilian convoy escapes.
missions.intel: Scout screens followed by Assault drones. A Heavy leads the final wave.
missions.preparation: Tutorial: aim and hold FIRE; reload with R. Build Machine Guns on slots 1 and 3 and a Cannon on 2. Use bounties for upgrades.
missions.objective: Survive every wave and keep the command bunker operational.
missions.narrative: Outpost Alpha holds. Asteria has time to mobilize.

missions.name: Red Hill Village
missions.briefing: Defend Sentinel-7. Destroy incoming drones before they reach the outpost.
missions.location: Central Asteria / Red Hill agricultural district
missions.story: Outpost Alpha is secure. Varkon drones now hunt supply trucks around Red Hill. Protect the village relay to reopen the northbound evacuation road.
missions.intel: Two approach corridors. Scouts probe both flanks; Assaults and Heavies pressure the later waves.
missions.preparation: Cover both roads early. Use Cannons against armor and Missile splash against groups. The sixth slot protects the western approach.
missions.objective: Survive every wave and keep the command bunker operational.

missions.name: East Supply Depot
missions.briefing: Defend Sentinel-7. Destroy incoming drones before they reach the outpost.
missions.story: Red Hill has restored our supply route. The Empire is converging on the eastern warehouse depot. Hold its power hub so Asterian forces can prepare a counterattack.
missions.intel: Top, west and east entries. Mixed late-wave groups contain multiple Heavies escorted by Assault drones.
missions.preparation: Use all seven slots. Build Cannons on both flanks and Missile coverage near the merge. Save your manual magazine for leaks during Heavy pushes.
missions.objective: Survive every wave and keep the command bunker operational.

missions.name: Broken Bridge
missions.briefing: The northern bridge has fallen. Sentinel-7 must hold the surviving causeway while engineers evacuate.
missions.story: The northern bridge has fallen. Sentinel-7 must hold the surviving causeway while engineers evacuate.
missions.intel: Scout Drone / Assault Drone / Heavy Drone / Shield Drone. Priority targets have colored markings and telegraphed abilities.
missions.preparation: Build overlapping automatic fire lanes. Manually focus shield emitters; AP rounds bypass their protection.
missions.objective: Survive every wave and keep the command bunker operational.

missions.name: Greyford
missions.briefing: A Varkon assault carrier commands Greyford. Break its exposed underside reactor and reopen the evacuation corridor.
missions.story: A Varkon assault carrier commands Greyford. Break its exposed underside reactor and reopen the evacuation corridor.
missions.intel: Scout Drone / Assault Drone / Heavy Drone / Shield Drone. Priority targets have colored markings and telegraphed abilities. Boss: Heavy Assault Carrier. Three phases; cyan core takes bonus manual damage. Eliminate charging escorts.
missions.preparation: Build overlapping automatic fire lanes. Manually focus shield emitters; AP rounds bypass their protection. Boss hull plating resists automatic fire. Aim at the cyan core before its siege capacitor fully charges.
missions.objective: Survive the escort waves, destroy Heavy Assault Carrier and protect the bunker.
missions.narrative: Greyford is free. The evacuation corridor is open and the first chapter checkpoint is secure.
